messages:
ara_sales: Quick sync re: NovaTech POC kickoff Monday. They pushed a few blockers on procurement/legal that we need to resolve before we flip billing: 1) they want the POC to be covered by a signed orderform only, no implicit overage billing; 2) DPA concern they cited an older subprocessor clause that permits broad transfers; 3) strong preference for customer-managed keys (HSM); 4) EU entity insists on paper signature for final MSA. tagging @omar_contracts @maya_billing @devin_se @sam_security.

omar_contracts: Can you paste their clause? If it's permissive transfer language that's a firm redline for us. We typically propose: "Vendor will notify and provide 30 days to object; named subprocessors appended."

ara_sales: Their exact wording:
```
"Customer consents to Vendors use of legacy subprocessors, including international transfers, without prior notice unless prior written approval is obtained."
```

omar_contracts: Yep, can't accept as-is. Options: 1) replace with notification + objection window + SCCs for transfers, or 2) move to an appendix listing subprocessors and require written consent for new ones. I'll prepare both redlines. ETA today.

maya_billing: On POC billing: our standard is free trial credits for the POC window; any consumption beyond those credits gets invoiced as overage on the next bill. For enterprise customers we can instead require a signed orderform and pre-bill credits. If NovaTech insists no billing without signed orderform, we need the PO before we open the environment. Net terms: finance defaults to Net30; Net45 requires CRO approval.

devin_se: KMS note: hosted API doesn't support customer HSM keys. Dedicated/Private does. Workarounds: client-side encryption or envelope encryption with our managed KMS scoped to the project, but procurement often won't accept. If they require HSM we need to spin up a Dedicated pilot (adds provisioning lead time ~7-12 business days and a price uplift).

sam_security: Also request: NovaTech fill our security questionnaire and provide SOC2 + any required regs. If the EU subsidiary is asking for paper signing, ask for the policy excerpt that mandates it. Most regulators accept eSign with audit trail. Link to sec questionnaire: https://redwood.example.com/security-questionnaire.

ara_sales: I'll ask them for the policy snippet. Meanwhile, two asks: Omar, can you drop both redline options into this thread so I can send to their counsel? Devin, please confirm lead time/cost delta for Dedicated. Maya, can you confirm if finance will approve Net45 for a named strategic account? Ops billing ops_billing: tagging you for PO flow and pre-bill options.

omar_contracts: Will add redlines here by 17:00 PST. Draft language: (1) "Vendor will maintain a list of subprocessors; Customer will be provided notice and a 30-day opportunity to object; transfers subject to SCCs or equivalent safeguards." (2) Appendix approach: "Named subprocessors only; additional subprocessors require written consent."

ops_billing: PO flow: we can withhold environment activation until PO/orderform is signed and billing contact on file. We can also accept an advance invoice to cover POC credits if they prefer to start immediately. Recommend adding an overage cap on the orderform to avoid disputes (e.g., $1,500).

devin_se: Confirming Dedicated: typical provisioning 7-12 business days; cost uplift ~20-40% depending on instance size. If they accept lower concurrency and smaller instances we can try a fast-track ~4 days at lower throughput. Also note: HSM binding needs to be configured during provisioning.

maya_billing: Finance note: Net45 needs commercial approval. If this is a strategic pilot with clear path to production, we can escalate but need a one-pager justification.

ara_sales: Good. I'll collect: their policy excerpt for wet-ink, billing contact/PO intent, and whether they will accept an overage cap or pre-bill. Will share Omar's redlines + questionnaire link.

docusign-bot: Created envelope ENV-9921 for NovaTech POC orderform (expires in 10 days). Signers: NovaTech PO, ara_sales. Status: pending.

sam_security: One more: if they want Dedicated for HSM, confirm that data residency constraints (EU-only) are captured in the orderform so we provision in the correct region.

ara_sales: Noted. I'll ask them about EU-only residency now. Thanks team 44b. I'll update this thread when they reply.

omar_contracts: Once they ack the redline option, I'll include fallback language: eSign for orderform to start POC with a limited liability clause; final MSA can be wet-ink if required. That keeps the pilot moving.

ops_billing: If we accept eSign now, we'll tag invoice metadata with "POC - eSign acknowledged; final MSA pending wet-ink" so finance doesn't recognize production revenue prematurely.

ara_sales: Perfect. Leaving this open until I get their follow-ups.
